observedGaps.repro: Build and attach price inventory in-memory; `phb-bo-stick` comparison 0 produces `/suggestedPrice/comparisons/0` with `sourceOwner=equipment:phb-spear`. `FirstEditionCitations.targets(comparison)` omits sourceOwner. The direct click is contextualized to phb-spear, and on reload app route searches that field pointer only in phb-spear targets, where it is absent. Current served dist/data.json has 662 field bindings while the current inventory builder validates 668, including six new comparator bindings; therefore the exact field-target round trip is not exercised by the current browser fixture. Existing browser assertion checks only that the reloaded viewer title is Spear; it does not assert field target identity/label, pending notice or exact target list.

Current viewer field-target browser test invokes FirstEditionSourceViewer.open() directly. Current app-level citation navigation unit test uses synthetic refs and source-function extraction; no browser test clicks an assembled equipment field target and then reloads that exact field URL.
The `Copy reference link` footer button copies only `#view/id`; no test asserts it or clarifies that it intentionally copies item-level rather than active source location.

Compact equipment/spell field-source layout emits inline chips, but spell table layout omits the source column (`attributeLayoutHTML` conditionally emits it only for equipment). No test verifies citations remain discoverable across compact/table toggles for spells.

Matrices are source-owner targets rather than root views. Existing tests cover fighter matrix context/reload, but no general page-only matrix route exists by design; sources/notebook pages have no source-navigation chip path tested beyond general app/accessibility tests.
